verdict.rationale: Morph offers batch offline completions (morph-docs-13) and fast bulk file-editing/apply capabilities (morph-docs-11, morph-gh-1), which support some bulk/automation-depth use cases, but there is no documented feature for bulk operations across many arbitrary items (e.g., batch file renames, mass repo-wide refactors, multi-item dataset operations) beyond chat completions and code apply. missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch operation APIs beyond chat completions, evidence of bulk operations across many discrete items (files, records, tickets) rather than just token throughput, independent verification of bulk reliability at scale.
